<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data there are three types of aliphatic carbons (O‑CH2 at ~62 ppm, CH2 at ~34 ppm, CH3 at ~19 ppm) each appearing twice, and an aromatic system with six distinct aromatic carbons. This pattern is consistent with a benzene core bearing two ethoxy‑type fragments and two methyl groups. The fragments that can be linked to give the overall formula C15H23O4 are therefore: a phenyl ring, two ethoxy fragments, and two methyl groups.</thought>
